rca of the issue: Original bugs were in: (a) Register.js missing patient-address-input + UserRegister/User pydantic models missing address field for patients - fixed by adding optional address field + conditional UI block. (b) search_doctors only used raw regex on user-typed keyword so 'cardiologue' didn't match 'Cardiologie' - fixed via keyword_aliases dict mapping French practitioner nouns to specialty root stems. (c) Login.js setTimeout had only patient vs default(doctor) branches, so partners landed on /doctor/dashboard and got rejected by doctor route guard - fixed by adding explicit 'partner' branch and updating Navbar dashboard link ternary.
